definition: sigma = (pi/h)/(c_s/r_c); sigma* = smallest sigma >= 1 with min E(phi; sigma) <= eps, bracketed to a relative width 0.001
kernel: phi = B_2 * g, g an expansion in 64 even PSWFs (checked with 80); C^2; phi' <= 0 on [0, P/2]; |phi'''| <= max|B_P'''|
band: limit of large boxes: the lattice of radius 80 with shells weighted by a radial trapezoid rule; checked with radius 160, with a spherical product rule, and in boxes of 10, 20, 40 r_c
